title.zh: 【Velodrome 与 Aerodrome 定于 10 月 21 日升级为 Aero，xVELO 须于 10 月 15 日前跨回 OP】 Foresight
title.en: 【Velodrome 与 Aerodrome 定于 10 月 21 日升级为 Aero，xVELO 须于 10 月 15 日前跨回 OP】 Foresight

current_state.zh: Velodrome and Aerodrome will merge into a unified DEX 'Aero' on Oct 21 launching on OP mainnet and Ink, with xVELO holders required to bridge back to OP by Oct 15 and gauges, emissions and cross-chain support shutting down across nine other networks.
current_state.en: Velodrome and Aerodrome will merge into a unified DEX 'Aero' on Oct 21 launching on OP mainnet and Ink, with xVELO holders required to bridge back to OP by Oct 15 and gauges, emissions and cross-chain support shutting down across nine other networks.
